input.sql:
set local transaction_read_only=on;
with recursive wanted(schema_name,relation_name) as (values ('public','audit_events'),('public','candidate_job_titles'),('public','candidates'),('public','client_settings'),('public','clients'),('public','rates_candidate_overrides'),('public','rates_client_defaults'),('public','timesheets'),('public','timesheets_financials'),('public','ts_financials_outbox'),('public','client_hospitals'),('public','tms_users'),('private','cloudtms_database_identity'),('private','bpay_next_module_control'),('private','cloudtms_database_releases')),
 selected_relations as (select c.*,n.nspname from wanted w join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.nspname=w.schema_name join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.relnamespace=n.oid and c.relname=w.relation_name),
 selected_indexes as (select i.*,c.relname as index_name,c.relam from pg_catalog.pg_index i join selected_relations r on r.oid=i.indrelid join pg_catalog.pg_class c on c.oid=i.indexrelid),
 selected_classes as (select distinct o.* from selected_indexes i cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(i.indclass::pg_catalog.oid[]) class_oid join pg_catalog.pg_opclass o on o.oid=class_oid),
 support_ids(oid) as (select a.amproc from selected_classes c join pg_catalog.pg_amproc a on a.amprocfamily=c.opcfamily union select o.oprcode from selected_classes c join pg_catalog.pg_amop a on a.amopfamily=c.opcfamily join pg_catalog.pg_operator o on o.oid=a.amopopr),
 type_walk(oid,path) as (select distinct a.atttypid,array[a.atttypid] from selected_relations r join pg_catalog.pg_attribute a on a.attrelid=r.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped
  union all select next_oid,w.path||next_oid from type_walk w join pg_catalog.pg_type t on t.oid=w.oid cross join lateral pg_catalog.unnest(array[t.typbasetype,t.typelem]) next_oid where next_oid<>0 and not next_oid=any(w.path) and pg_catalog.cardinality(w.path)<16),
 selected_types as (select distinct t.* from type_walk w join pg_catalog.pg_type t on t.oid=w.oid)
select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('version','DAILY_GENUINE_S0_CATALOGUE_ONLY_V1','database',pg_catalog.current_database(),'databaseOid',(select oid::pg_catalog.int8 from pg_catalog.pg_database where datname=pg_catalog.current_database()),
 'readOnly',pg_catalog.current_setting('transaction_read_only')::pg_catalog.bool,'noRoleSwitch',current_user=session_user,'currentSchemas',pg_catalog.current_schemas(true),'observedAt',pg_catalog.clock_timestamp(),
 'holderGranted',exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_locks where locktype='advisory' and database=71 and pid=601 and classid=20261013 and objid=1 and objsubid=2 and mode='ExclusiveLock' and granted),
 'relations',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('schema',r.nspname,'name',r.relname,'oid',r.oid,'owner',pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(r.relowner),'kind',r.relkind,'persistence',r.relpersistence,'isPartition',r.relispartition,'rowSecurity',r.relrowsecurity,'forceRowSecurity',r.relforcerowsecurity,
  'inheritsParents',(select pg_catalog.count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_inherits h where h.inhrelid=r.oid),'inheritsChildren',(select pg_catalog.count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_inherits h where h.inhparent=r.oid),'foreignTable',exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_foreign_table f where f.ftrelid=r.oid),
  'selectAllowed',pg_catalog.has_table_privilege(current_user,r.oid,'SELECT'),'schemaUsage',pg_catalog.has_schema_privilege(current_user,r.relnamespace,'USAGE'),
  'rules',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.pg_get_ruledef(x.oid,true) order by x.rulename) from pg_catalog.pg_rewrite x where x.ev_class=r.oid),
  'policies',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('name',p.polname,'roles',p.polroles,'command',p.polcmd,'using',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),'check',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) order by p.polname) from pg_catalog.pg_policy p where p.polrelid=r.oid)) order by r.nspname,r.relname) from selected_relations r),
 'types',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',t.typname,'oid',t.oid,'kind',t.typtype,'base',t.typbasetype,'element',t.typelem,'input',t.typinput::pg_catalog.regprocedure::pg_catalog.text,'output',t.typoutput::pg_catalog.regprocedure::pg_catalog.text,'receive',t.typreceive::pg_catalog.regprocedure::pg_catalog.text,'send',t.typsend::pg_catalog.regprocedure::pg_catalog.text,'enumLabels',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel order by e.enumsortorder) from pg_catalog.pg_enum e where e.enumtypid=t.oid)) order by n.nspname,t.typname) from selected_types t join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=t.typnamespace),
 'typeWalkComplete',not exists(select 1 from type_walk w join pg_catalog.pg_type t on t.oid=w.oid where pg_catalog.cardinality(w.path)=16 and (t.typbasetype<>0 or t.typelem<>0)),
 'indexes',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('relation',i.indrelid::pg_catalog.regclass::pg_catalog.text,'name',i.index_name,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'live',i.indislive,'accessMethod',a.amname,'definition',pg_catalog.pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid),'expression',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indexprs,i.indrelid),'predicate',pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),'operatorClasses',i.indclass,'collations',i.indcollation) order by i.indexrelid) from selected_indexes i join pg_catalog.pg_am a on a.oid=i.relam),
 'collationBindings',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(c) order by c.oid) from pg_catalog.pg_collation c where c.oid in (select pg_catalog.unnest(i.indcollation::pg_catalog.oid[]) from selected_indexes i)),
 'operatorClasses',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.opcname,'oid',c.oid,'family',c.opcfamily,'inputType',c.opcintype::pg_catalog.regtype::pg_catalog.text,'extension',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',e.extnamespace::pg_catalog.regnamespace::pg_catalog.text) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on e.oid=d.refobjid where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_opclass'::pg_catalog.regclass and d.objid=c.oid and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass and d.deptype='e')) order by n.nspname,c.opcname) from selected_classes c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.opcnamespace),
 'supportBindings',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::pg_catalog.regprocedure::pg_catalog.text,'schema',n.nspname,'language',l.lanname,'definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'library',p.probin,'symbol',case when l.lanname in ('c','internal') then p.prosrc else null end,'sourceSha256',pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(p.prosrc,'UTF8')),'hex'),
  'extension',(select pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',e.extnamespace::pg_catalog.regnamespace::pg_catalog.text) from pg_catalog.pg_depend d join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on e.oid=d.refobjid where d.classid='pg_catalog.pg_proc'::pg_catalog.regclass and d.objid=p.oid and d.refclassid='pg_catalog.pg_extension'::pg_catalog.regclass and d.deptype='e')) order by n.nspname,p.oid)
  from (select oid from support_ids union select pg_catalog.unnest(array[t.typinput::pg_catalog.oid,t.typoutput::pg_catalog.oid,t.typreceive::pg_catalog.oid,t.typsend::pg_catalog.oid,t.typmodin::pg_catalog.oid,t.typmodout::pg_catalog.oid]) from selected_types t) s
  join pg_catalog.pg_proc p on p.oid=s.oid join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace join pg_catalog.pg_language l on l.oid=p.prolang)) as s0_catalogue;
